summary: Applicant Screening, Background Checks, Benefits Administration, Compliance, Compensation, Drug Testing, EEO Inquiries, Employee Relations, Event Planning, Full-Cycle Recruitment, Interviewing, Investigations, New Hire Orientation, Performance Evaluations, Reference Checks, Policy & Procedure Administration, Training and Development, Worker's Compensation, Unemployment Claims.

experience.title: HR Coordinator
responsibilities: Developed and coordinated comprehensive recruitment, selection, and placement programs for teacher vacancies across multiple schools.
Conducted applicant screening, interviews, and recruitment presentations at job fairs and on-campus events.
Ensured compliance with federal, state, and school board policies and administrative procedures.
Counseled employees on personnel concerns and assisted in grievance arbitration.
Collaborated with other HR coordinators to forecast recruitment needs and manage travel for out-of-state recruitment.

experience.title: Human Resources Consultant
responsibilities: Investigated employee relations complaints and recommended resolutions.
Provided counsel to managers and employees on performance management and policy issues.
Managed the Employee Relations Hotline and investigation process.
Coordinated recruitment processes, including ad review, applicant screening, and pre‑employment checks.
Maintained data in HRIS applicant tracking database and participated in job fairs.

experience.title: Human Resources Manager/Coordinator
responsibilities: Established the HR department for a new start‑up hospital.
Recruited senior executives and managed full‑cycle recruitment.
Developed affirmative action and EEO programs, and maintained compliance records.
Conducted new employee orientation, managed identification badges, and handled unemployment claims.
Hosted staff town‑hall meetings and facilitated employee surveys.

experience.title: Human Resources Manager
responsibilities: Managed a staff of HR employees and oversaw HR functions.
Developed and distributed employee newsletters and managed workers' compensation.
Coached management on performance issues and HR compliance.
Coordinated employee events such as team building and recognition programs.
